title: Macanese Patois
description: Portuguese-based creole spoken by a minority in Macau
extract: Macanese patois, also called Maquista, is a Portuguese-based creole language with a substrate from Cantonese, Malay and Sinhala, which was originally spoken by the Macanese community of the Portuguese colony of Macau. It is now spoken by a few families in Macau and in the Macanese diaspora.
